title: Tool registry marks external readers; each returns tainted results
goal: Each tool that reads mail, MCP results, browser pages, files or Telegram media is marked and its results are tainted
acceptance: Registering an unmarked tool that reads outside data fails a check, not only the test
The threat map cites the test
privacy: Neutral fixtures and invented data only; no secrets, tokens or personal data in Git.
escalation: A material scope or effort increase goes to the owner

effort.basis: Estimated 2026-11-26: one registry field, marks on the readers, any missing taint. Not a measurement.
